title: This merge proposal makes the clang compiler driver behave more like GCC when requesting debug symbol generation.
description:
This merge proposal makes the clang compiler driver behave more like GCC when requesting debug symbol generation.

GCC shipped in Ubuntu will record command-line switches in the debug symbols; the patch included in this change will make clang do the same.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index bbfbc31..f18dd33 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+llvm-toolchain-18 (1:18.1.6-1ubuntu1) oracular; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/p/clang-record-gcc-switches-by-default.patch: add a patch to force clang
+    record gcc switches by default
+
+ -- Zixing Liu <zixing.liu@canonical.com>  Tue, 04 Jun 2024 16:44:07 -0600
+
 llvm-toolchain-18 (1:18.1.6-1) unstable; urgency=medium
 
   * New upstream release
diff --git a/debian/patches/clang-record-gcc-switches-by-default.patch b/debian/patches/clang-record-gcc-switches-by-default.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e97a167
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/clang-record-gcc-switches-by-default.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+Description: Record GCC-style command-line switches by default
+ This makes Clang default behaviour more like GCC where if debug
+ symbol generation is enabled, the command-line switches data
+ will be stored inside the debug symbols.
+Author: Zixing Liu <zixing.liu@canonical.com>
+Forwarded: no
+Last-Update: 2024-06-04
+---
+This patch header follows DEP-3: http://dep.debian.net/deps/dep3/
+Index: llvm-toolchain-18-18.1.6/clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Clang.cpp
+===================================================================
+--- llvm-toolchain-18-18.1.6.orig/clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Clang.cpp
++++ llvm-toolchain-18-18.1.6/clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Clang.cpp
+@@ -7390,7 +7390,7 @@ void Clang::ConstructJob(Compilation &C,
+   // By default, -gno-record-gcc-switches is set on and no recording.
+   auto GRecordSwitches =
+       Args.hasFlag(options::OPT_grecord_command_line,
+-                   options::OPT_gno_record_command_line, false);
++                   options::OPT_gno_record_command_line, true);
+   auto FRecordSwitches =
+       Args.hasFlag(options::OPT_frecord_command_line,
+                    options::OPT_fno_record_command_line, false);
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series
index 20e2454..8892db2 100644
--- a/debian/patches/series
+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -151,3 +151,4 @@ arm32-defaults.diff
 mips/D154390-pre-R6.diff
 libsanitizer-timebits.diff
 ubuntu-releases.patch
+clang-record-gcc-switches-by-default.patch
